question: Town M is to the north of Town N. Town N is to the east of Town O. Town O is to the west of Town P. Town P is to the south of Town Q. Town M is to the south-west of Town Q. What is the position of Town N with respect to Town P?
solution:
Given, 

Town M is to the north of Town N.

Town N is to the east of Town O.

Town O is to the west of Town P.

Town P is to the south of Town Q.

Town M is to the south-west of Town Q.

Then,

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/bdb3728cf253f368ddcc06bfba2612a968ef1e3dbef9e81f9c02d3f97b6dcb6f.png] 

Position of Town N with respect to Town P is in **West.**

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 3".
